# Profile Hub Dossier (PHD)
> Profile Hub Dossier (PHD) is a local-first, privacy-focused iOS and Android app for tracking personal records through custom profiles — including Beauty/Cosmetic, MoneyFlow, and Education. No account required, no camera/mic/location access, no AI training on user data. $29.99/year with a 14-day free trial.

## Pages
- [beauty-collection-declutter-tracker/makeup-inventory-organizer.html](https://profilehubdossier.github.io/beauty-collection-declutter-tracker/makeup-inventory-organizer.html): Stop wasting money on expired products and duplicate buys — how PHD helps you organize, declutter, and track your beauty inventory before you shop new trends. FAQ and app download link included.
